veranderings.rede: Both forms are correct, but the decided habitat definition in the glossary says 'lewe', so the body sentence should use the same verb.

veranderings.voor: of dit hou iets binne veilig
veranderings.na: of dit hou iets daarbinne veilig
veranderings.rede: 'iets binne' is vague; 'daarbinne' makes it clear that the thing is kept safe inside the structure.
When you list separate things, 'almal' is the right word; 'alles' is for a mass or a whole.

veranderings.voor: Baie voëlneste is soos 'n diep koppie
veranderings.na: Baie voëlneste lyk soos 'n diep koppie
veranderings.rede: 'lyk soos' is the natural way to compare a shape; 'is soos' sounds wooden.
'daarom' is the more natural linking word for a reason in a learner's text; 'dus' reads like a conclusion in an argument.

veranderings.voor: Die plek waar 'n dier veilig is
veranderings.rede: A shelter is one of many places, as the study text itself says ('n Skuiling is 'n plek ...), so the indefinite article fits better than 'Die'.

vlae.teks: 'n Raamstruktuur is los dele wat aanmekaar sit met oop plekke tussenin.
vlae.rede: This study-text sentence repeats the decided raamstruktuur definition but ends in 'tussenin' where the decided wording says 'tussen hulle'. Someone should decide whether the body should match the decided wording word for word; not changed because it touches a decided definition.
